svg.text: The fleet measures itself — including where it falls short
Every figure below is from this repository's own ledger, dated. The most useful capability mac has is that its instrumentation can indict its own design.
What it measures
Review experiments
Pre-registered arms, propensity retained, deterministic assignment from
(experiment_id, task_id, policy_version). A blind arm withholds executor
evidence for an independent discovery pass.
Scientific optimizer
Policies, experiments, assignments, observations and decisions as durable
tables. Emits a policy candidate; promotion stays an operator gate.
Dreaming — memory that must shrink
Copy-on-write runs, gated on provenance, contradiction reduction, privacy,
retrieval quality, compression and win balance. A run whose output exceeds
0.75× its input is quarantined; promotion retires the rows it supersedes.
Fleet operational learning
Repository-access outcomes are control inputs, not log lines: a proven
success is preferred for later routing, a proven failure removes that agent
from equivalent routing until a cooldown expires. Credentials are never stored.
Also: eval sets with scoring direction and regression thresholds · task throughput
observability · hub event-loop stall detection · classified attempt failures.

64% of routes stream. Cost is not stored — it is priced against a catalog at read time, and reports say "missing", never zero.
Ledger census — 2026-08-25 (live hub)
blocked 378 · waiting 29 · open 94 · running 1

(ADR 0018). That dead-dep query was not re-run for this
census; blocked has grown to 378, not shrunk.
OPEN DECISIONS AT THIS COMMIT — THREE THE MEASUREMENTS ARE FORCING (16 ADRs STILL PROPOSED)
ADR 0029 · Proposed
The route search path is a fleet contract
Coding-agent choice lived in per-worker environment:
a pinned variable, an exported key, an edited unit
file. No two hosts were obliged to agree.
When one account exhausts, every worker rediscovers
it independently, one wasted turn at a time.
The decision is recorded; the ordered ladder is not
yet the runtime search path on every host.
Proposal: one fleet-wide ordered ladder, quota
learning, and a bus event when a route is skipped.
ADR 0017 · Proposed
Meter token spend at the router
Usage lives as one observability event per request,
with token counts inside a JSON text column.
There is no token table and no cost column. Cost is
computed at read time against a models catalog, and
returns whether it could be priced at all.
With 29.5% of routes reporting no input tokens and
none reporting cache hits, spend cannot currently be
attributed with confidence.
Proposal: meter at the router, where the truth is,
rather than trusting what the client reports.
ADR 0018 · Proposed
The task view is a graph, not a board
The console can say how many tasks are blocked. It
cannot say what blocks them, because the hub never
sends the edges — the client has no dependency field.
On a board, a task whose dependency lands in five
minutes and one that is permanently dead look
exactly the same.
"A state whose p50 dwell is measured in days is not a
queue, it is a graveyard."
Proposal: ship the dependency edges and present the
work as a graph under progressive disclosure.
